name: smooth
description: Talk to your business. Smoo AI's `th` CLI as an MCP server. Local work-tracking (pearls) and notes (memory) work out of the box; org tools — the Smooth Operator agent and knowledge search — unlock after Sign in with Smoo (`th auth login`).

tools.name: pearls_ready
tools.description: List work items (pearls) that are ready to work on now — open, unblocked, highest priority first.

tools.name: pearls_create
tools.description: Create a new work item (pearl). Returns the new pearl id.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save a note to local memory (kept in this workspace). Free — no sign-in.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: List recent notes from local memory. Free — no sign-in.

tools.name: knowledge_search
tools.description: Search your Smoo org's knowledge base and return the most relevant passages. Requires Sign in with Smoo (`th auth login`).

tools.name: ask_business
tools.description: Talk to your business in plain language. Smooth Operator (the agent on your Smoo org) answers questions about revenue/CRM/knowledge and can draft — and, with your approval, send — email. Needs Sign in with Smoo (`th auth login`).
